mapper.insert: insert into mxk_apps_saml_v20_details( id, certissuer, certsubject, certexpiration, keystore, spacsurl, issuer, entityid, validityinterval, nameidformat, nameidconvert, nameidsuffix, audience, encrypted, binding, signature, digestmethod, metaurl, instid) values ( #{id}, #{certIssuer}, #{certSubject}, #{certExpiration}, #{keyStore}, #{spAcsUrl}, #{issuer}, #{entityId}, #{validityInterval}, #{nameidFormat}, #{nameIdConvert}, #{nameIdSuffix}, #{audience}, #{encrypted}, #{binding}, #{signature}, #{digestMethod}, #{metaUrl}, #{instId})
mapper.update: update mxk_apps_saml_v20_details set certissuer = #{et.certIssuer}, certsubject = #{et.certSubject}, certexpiration = #{et.certExpiration}, keystore = #{et.keyStore}, spacsurl = #{et.spAcsUrl}, issuer = #{et.issuer}, entityid = #{et.entityId}, validityinterval = #{et.validityInterval}, nameidformat = #{et.nameidFormat}, nameidconvert = #{et.nameIdConvert}, nameidsuffix = #{et.nameIdSuffix}, audience = #{et.audience}, encrypted = #{et.encrypted}, binding = #{et.binding}, signature = #{et.signature}, digestmethod = #{et.digestMethod}, metaurl = #{et.metaUrl}, instid = #{et.instId} where id = #{et.id}
mapper.select: select svd.certissuer, svd.certsubject, svd.certexpiration, svd.keystore, svd.spacsurl, svd.issuer, svd.entityid, svd.audience, svd.validityinterval, svd.nameidformat, svd.encrypted, svd.binding, svd.nameidconvert, svd.signature, svd.digestmethod, svd.metaurl, app.* from mxk_apps_saml_v20_details svd, mxk_apps app where app.instid = svd.instid and app.id = #{value} and svd.id = #{value} and svd.id = app.id and app.status = 1
